B.text: If the map colors are bound to state population using the legend's ordered ranges, an orange state is encoded as 30+ M and a purple state as 20-30 M. The highest-population routing option can be justified only when the chart distinguishes the selected state's population from every other offered state; membership in the same open-ended top bin does not establish an ordering within that bin.
B.conditions: Applies if the title and legend describe the mapped state population values and the workflow requires the single highest-population offered state.
